# Second Wind

Second Wind sells AWS knowledge, guidance and advice. Products are sold whole through x402 on Base.

Discover products at https://secondwindai.com/api/tools. Select and configure a product, review its exact payment requirements, and authorize payment. Preserve your purchase URL and private recovery token for redelivery.

Interfaces: https://secondwindai.com/openapi.json and https://secondwindai.com/capnp.

Use each listing’s deliverable, license, provenance, supported boundary and release hash to assess it.
